about: state-lower contests of 1978 in Massachusetts, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local.py from pipeline/intake/klarner_state_legislative.py's cache.

party_codes.4008: Klarner's codebook (Appendix C): assumed non-major party because no party was listed next to the name in the returns, where parties were generally listed
party_codes.99997: Klarner's codebook (Appendix C): assumed non-major party because the election is fully contested and no party was given in the prior database
